title: Veterinary Technology
author: Dayone Koo
_comment: PROGRAM EVALUATION (evaluate-program skill). Subject is the PROGRAM (Foothill College x TOP 010210), not a job title. Destination SOCs DERIVED: crosswalk(010210) intersected with SECTORS['agwet'].socs minus ALL_OTHER/PROMOTION/EXPERIENCE_5YR = ['29-2056', '31-9096']. Dropped: 11-1021, 11-3012, 11-9111, 25-1071, 43-1011, 43-4171, 43-6013, 99-9999. Peer set = top 2 Bay colleges by 5-year awards on THIS TOP (a program evaluation's peers must share the TOP; the role report mixed TOPs). live_postings and competencies reused verbatim from the matching role report (same SOCs, already verified). EVIDENCE-FORWARD, NO VERDICT.
lede: This evaluation assembles labor-market supply and demand evidence for Foothill College's Veterinary Technology program (TOP 010210). It covers regional occupational demand targeted by the program, and the program's award and enrollment trends in the context of other colleges offering the same program in the region.
demand_note: Foothill's Veterinary Technology program leads to SOC 29-2056 and SOC 31-9096 via the TOP–CIP–SOC crosswalk. [According to the Centers of Excellence](https://datastudio.google.com/u/0/reporting/5060057c-b9ba-4081-9ed7-83356eaa7061), these occupations demand roughly 1,130 openings a year.
alignment_note: The set of colleges offering TOP 010210 in the Bay Area. All of these colleges support SOC 29-2056 and 31-9096 via the same TOP code through the TOP–CIP–SOC crosswalk.
award_note: Award trends for each member-college program. Empty cells indicate no data reported via DataMart.
enrollment_note: Enrollment trends for each member-college program. Empty cells indicate no data reported via DataMart.
